Your data

How your data is handled

This page sets the structure of the notice. The legal text itself is written by a lawyer before launch.

What is collected

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • Which fields are required at sign up?
  • Is the original transcript file kept, or only the extracted text?
  • What usage data or technical logs are collected?

Why it is collected

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • What is the lawful basis for each processing purpose? Explicit consent is the only basis available.
  • Is data used to improve the models? If so, under what consent?

How long it is kept

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • How long is an inactive account kept?
  • When are uploaded files permanently deleted?

Who it is shared with

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • Who are the hosting and processing providers, and where are their servers?
  • Does data leave Oman, and under what safeguards?

Your rights

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • How does a user request a copy of their data?
  • How is consent withdrawn, and what happens after withdrawal?
  • What is the response time for requests?

Contact the data officer

A lawyer completes this section. Questions to answer:

  • Who is the data protection officer?
  • What is the official email and postal address?
